# PoupaMarket Copilot and Codex Instructions

- Use TypeScript for all application code.
- Use Next.js App Router conventions.
- Prefer mobile-first layouts and interactions.
- Use Tailwind CSS for styling.
- Keep components small and focused.
- Keep domain logic outside UI components when possible.
- Use English for comments and documentation.
- Do not add Supabase until the planned sync phase.
- Do not add scraping.
- Do not add OCR.
- Do not add payments.
- Do not introduce complex backend architecture in Phase 0.
- Prefer simple, readable code over clever abstractions.
- Document important architectural decisions in `docs/`.
